quotes.quote: Is he dealing with his own inner shadow (the karmic residue at the depths of his own Eighth House)

Pluto rules the unconscious depths of the Scorpio or Eighth House personality, with its residue of instinctual drives, emotional attachments, and compulsive-obsessive tendencies carried forward from past lives to the present.
According to Alice Bailey it is Mars, not Pluto, that functions as esoteric ruler of Scorpio.
